title: Integrate untrusted content adapter into AgentCore workflow
purpose: Wire the content adapter contract into AgentCore so fetch, sanitize, summarize, and source-to-sink checks are repeatable runtime workflows.
scope: Consume typed content fetch and sanitization reports.
Keep sanitized summary as replanning-only context.
Use source-to-sink policy before any high-risk sink.
Project denied injection attempts into audit and operator views.
implementation_steps: Add content workflow execution over typed fetch/sanitize/summary reports.
Add fixtures for valid local content, digest mismatch, over-size content, and shell-injection text.
Assert direct shell/secret/privileged/exfiltration sinks do not prepare effects.
Record evidence with audit projection examples.
acceptance_criteria: External content remains untrusted unless explicitly operator-origin.
Digest mismatch and size limit fail closed.
Sanitized summaries cannot create tool calls.
Denied high-risk sink is visible and effect-free.
failure_modes: Raw external content is fed to planner as authority.
Sanitized summary becomes a direct tool call.
Denied sink still prepares an effect.

blocked_until: Content workflow tests and evidence pass.
